desc: Factor every A_i and compute a_i=v_p(A_i), S_p=sum_i a_i per relevant prime (skip primes with S_p=0)
Implement prime-wise zero-hit DP: dp[height][flag], init dp[c][c==0]=p^c for c in 0..S_p, transitions e->e±a_i staying in [0,S_p], set flag when reaching 0, sum flagged finals
Handle degenerate cases: a_i=0 edges as single no-move transition, S_p=0 => contribution 1, and heights provably bounded by S_p
Multiply per-prime contributions mod 998244353 and implement stdin/stdout
Validate on all 3 samples and edge cases (N=2, all A_i=1, repeated prime powers); confirm complexity O((N-1)*sum_p S_p) is acceptable
